metadata.description: Claude Code mods: an office of your running sessions, an image viewfinder and an ambient animation strip.

plugins.name: office
plugins.description: A pixel-art office of your running Claude Code sessions, animated by what each one is doing.

plugins.name: viewfinder
plugins.description: Shows the images and screenshots Claude looks at, in a pane or above the prompt.

plugins.name: ambient
plugins.description: An animated strip above the prompt that follows Claude's work, in eight styles.
